about: D-SINK-80 (2026-11-05): the M3U attribute grammar, the helper's parse_attrs (bin/helper 02-sources.py), which serves #EXTINF and #EXTM3U. The shell has no M3U parser, so this fixture is the helper's alone (tests/test_attr_grammar.py). `line` is a whole #EXTINF or #EXTM3U line; `attrs` is what the attributes parse to; `title` is parse_extinf's title, or for #EXTM3U the remainder parse_attrs returns (discarded by parse_m3u). `stored`, where present, is the row parse_m3u writes for that line followed by a stream URL (the header's `epgUrlHint` for #EXTM3U): `id` ending in `:` is a scheme prefix only, and a null field is absent; since the recheck of the review's F1 (2026-11-06) a logo or a guide hint whose value ran past where every earlier release ended it is stored as none (own_value), unless a hint's comma-joined list opens exactly there. `plain` false holds a case to the sinks that delete control characters before they redact (the player's title, the notification body) only. `cost` marks a stated cost of the URL-run rule, `accepted` D-SINK-34's accepted class (an ASCII delimiter inside a URL ends its run at every redactor, so no grammar keeps it whole for them). The credential is spelt in `secret`'s letters, which nothing else here holds.
